title: The dead apex-mirror staleness step takes 7.5 of Portfolio validate's 10 minutes
problem: 'Check the apex tool mirror is not stale' guards gitops/prod/front-door*, the mirror of the k3s origin retired 2026-10-01; it serves nothing (portfolio/hosting/README.md). It still runs on every PR and every push to main and is most of the job's time while runners are starved.
change: In .github/workflows/portfolio-validate.yml, run that step (and 'Check the apex tool mirror has room left' if it reads the same tree) only when the change touches gitops/prod/ or the mirror's generator: add an earlier step that sets an output from `git diff --name-only <base>...HEAD` (on push use github.event.before as in the venture-regression step), and gate with `if:`. Do not delete the generator. Check CLAUDE.md / verify-and-merge.md lines that name the step and keep them true.
metric: Portfolio validate job duration on a PR that does not touch gitops/prod/
baseline: ~10 min, of which 7 min 36 s is this step (run 39398672489, 2026-10-20)
